name: Urban Company (partner)
fees: Platform commission; earnings index is net of commissions, fees, travel and product costs
requirements: Professional skill (beauty, cleaning, repairs), smartphone, kits/training; NSDC-certified credentials; insurance ₹10 L life + ₹6 L disability
verdict: Highest realistic net of any platform reviewed; best if you have a saleable service skill.

name: Swiggy (food delivery)
payout_method: Weekly bank transfer (Mon–Sun cycle paid Wed/Thu)
requirements: 18+; Aadhaar, PAN, 2-wheeler DL, RC, bank account, Android smartphone; no education requirement
verdict: Most widely available delivery channel; realistic net ~₹18k–28k in metros on a full-time schedule.

name: Zomato (food delivery)
requirements: 18+; Aadhaar, PAN, DL, RC, bank account; bicycle/low-speed EV riders do not need a DL
verdict: Broad availability and weekly pay; metro net in line with other food-delivery platforms.

name: Blinkit
requirements: 18+; Aadhaar, PAN, DL, RC, bank account; insurance ₹10 L life + ₹1 L health
verdict: Short dark-store trips keep costs low; ranked among the best net-per-hour delivery options.

name: Flipkart / Ekart delivery partner
requirements: 18+; Aadhaar, PAN, DL, RC, bank account
verdict: Predictable e-commerce runs; metro net mid-band with reliability bonuses.

name: Swiggy Instamart
requirements: 18+; Aadhaar, PAN, DL, RC, bank account, Android smartphone
verdict: Short dark-store trips keep fuel lower than food delivery; decent metro net.

name: Zepto
payout_method: Weekly bank transfer (Tue/Wed for the prior week)
requirements: 18+; Aadhaar, PAN, DL, RC, bank account
verdict: Comparable to Blinkit; strong insurance and referral perks for quick-commerce riders.

name: BigBasket / BB Now
requirements: 18+; Aadhaar, PAN, DL, RC, bank account
verdict: Steady grocery-delivery work; net sits in the middle of the quick-commerce band.

name: Amazon Flex (India)
payout_method: As early as next day to your selected payment day
payout_timing: Next day to selected payment day
requirements: 18+ (2-wheeler/e-bike) or 20+ (3-wheeler); PAN mandatory; Android 13+ with 3 GB RAM; DL, RC, insurance, PUC; background check
verdict: Good top-up income at up to ₹140/hour, but never a reliable full-time job.

name: Porter
fees: Porter charges up to ~30% commission on the driver's fare
requirements: 2-wheeler/3-wheeler/tempo RC, DL, insurance, PAN, bank account
verdict: Solid logistics option for 2-wheeler owners; watch the ~30% commission.
